items.question: Which additional beings are proclaimed to belong to this enumerated series?
premises: The ant is named as part of the series.
The earth-snake is named as part of the series.
Beings beginning with the spider are proclaimed as included.
items.inference: These creatures further extend the previously enumerated series of beings.
items.plain_english: And the ant, the earth-snake, and those beginning with the spider are proclaimed as included.
